summary: Memory Resonance is the locus where memories, identities, and unrealized timelines manifest physically. Echo crystals amplify forgotten experiences, while resonance lakes reflect possible futures.
history: Formed when the Void absorbed fragments of identity from collapsing timelines.
Echo crystals grew from resonance feedback loops.
Creatures born of fractured identity emerged from the basins.
The Resonant Mind arose as the embodiment of collective memory collapse.
